system.description:
You create the image of yourself that enlarges and attempts to crush your target by stepping on them.

Select one creature you can see within range, and make a range Genjutsu attack, dealing 5d10 psychic damage. On a successful hit, the target must also make a Wisdom saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s secondary effects.

Failure: Affected creatures falls Prone and find it difficult to stand. If they would attempt to stand, they must spend all of their movement.

Critical Failure: Affected creature falls Prone and cannot stand. They remain Prone until another creature assists them to help them stand. While Prone in this way, their movement speed is 0.
